source.title: Treads of the Greatlynx — Wowhead item-side cumulative Looter disenchant outcomes
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated submissions)

notes: Original item-side cumulative, anonymous Looter source row 1/3 for leather feet (druid); 46 source-reported disenchants. The item was added in patch 11.0.0; that does NOT establish collection build or patch. Wowhead public text strips the output rank-specific link ID; source shows same material name in distinct rows, so rank and item ID remain unknown. No source per-positive stack quantity, total units, skill, specialization, input variant/bonus/ilvl, participants, histograms, or individual zero bins; do not derive stack sizes, zeros or rates from row-sum. Especially for 20th Anniversary reissues, cross-expansion outcomes may depend on item variant/era and must not be treated as current-patch or ordinary Khaz Algar gear yield. Disenchanting has no ore/herb refund basis; character build unspecified. Distinct rows share ONE 46-event cohort; do not count as independent operation samples.
